sn50.1-12:1.1: The five powers are practically identical to the five spiritual faculties (SN 48.43). The 108 discourses in this Saṁyutta are merely stock passages and abbreviations. The analysis lacking here is found in a series of Suttas at AN 5.13–16. | The Chinese version in SA gathers many of the discourses on different sets of “powers” that the Pali scatters about the canon.
